source_text: Apparuerunt Domino Abrahae ad ilicem Mambre tres viri. Hospitalitas Abrahae — lavant pedes, panem afferunt. Unus loquitur ut Dominus; duo pergunt ad Sodomam.
pass_a_gloss: Appeared to-Lord to-Abraham at oak of-Mamre three men. Hospitality of-Abraham — they-wash feet, bread they-bring. One speaks as Lord; two proceed to Sodom.
pass_b_english: [[The Lord appeared to Abraham by the oak of Mamre >> Bible:Genesis 18:1]]; [[three men >> Bible:Genesis 18:2]] stand by him. Abraham’s hospitality — feet washed, bread brought. One speaks as the Lord; two go on toward Sodom.
